response.sql: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS status, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scan_count, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS gb_per_minute_rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute_rate) AS mean_status_rate FROM status_rates) SELECT status, total_scan_count, gb_per_minute_rate, gb_per_minute_rate - mean_status_rate AS difference_from_average FROM status_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE gb_per_minute_rate > mean_status_rate
